items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Wingie got Paul Marés besides himself, Floyd O'Brien, I remember that... And we had every hot musician... in that band.

ctx.x: This was on -- I don't know if it was the first or the second. It was on Madison Street, and I think it was down in the basement. That was it. And they played Louis Armstrong in that place. Now, the plan starts to unfold here, I didn't know when I got when I hired these guys. And the plan is that we're going to replace Freddie Moore with Zutty Singleton. We're going to replace Lee Collins with Wild Bill Davis. We're going to replace Floyd O'Brien with George Brunis. And we're going to get Bechet to get on and get…
